test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed079e56f511f2b5119275a9e92435a276e76a0481cf64928e701f0f5d0e1235.png] 

The logic follow here is:

Logic: Letter + 3 = Next letter.

Option 1) YBE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83d62410450f27aef98cdab871905a54cdf6ca4d7d2559a23245bef271898dfa.png] 

**Option 2) TWY**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7df2a3dd86b172653cfc5e6be00d6ce0dfc8535eedfa5b9400061e79ed777b17.png] 

Option 3) WZC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/938417c5126b20a584e4e91ee0b2958dcdbba88787b845641a725d479f696432.png] 

Option 4) NQT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2773de075e0fc66d29ada3a6c7597414efbe553502bb66cbbecbeae9cbd2f710.png] 

Thus, **'TWY'** not follow the same logic.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
